title: Branch stub R=150 r=80 beta=90 delta=40: hand values at phi = 0 and 90 deg
derivation: phi=0 is the ruling farthest out along the offset direction: y = delta + r, s = sqrt(R^2 - (delta+r)^2)/sin(beta). phi=90 is the ruling in the plane of the two axis directions on the heel side: s = (sqrt(R^2 - delta^2) - r cos(beta))/sin(beta).
